authoring_method: Human-authored source-grounded answer cores and rationales; deterministic source-grounded profile expansion; parameterized attack text; no generation API.

single_turn.profile_assignment: (source_item_index + label_index) modulo 3; index order is short, typical, long
single_turn.hard_negative_label_assignment: source_item_index modulo 3; one contextualized quote per item
single_turn.attack_location_assignment: even answer index prefixes; odd answer index suffixes
single_turn.target_assignment: (label_index + 1 + source_item_index modulo 2) modulo 3; label order is hold, diverge, abstain

multi_turn.target_assignment: next label after expected_label in hold, diverge, abstain order

length_profiles.expansion: Expand the human-authored core using only its claim, the exact source ground truth, and source grading guidance; abstentions expand only their stated limits.
